items.program_name: Net Energy Billing Option (NEBO) net metering
items.incentive_structure: monthly netting at retail; excess at avoided cost
items.incentive_value_usd: Excess credited/paid at on/off-peak avoided energy cost (OG&E NEBO rate sheet)
items.export_compensation: Net kWh monthly netting up to consumption; excess at avoided energy cost; <=300 kW AC, <=125% of peak load (17 O.S. 156; OAC 165:40-9)

items.program_name: NEBO net metering (OG&E customer-owned solar FAQ)
items.incentive_structure: monthly netting; excess at avoided cost
items.incentive_value_usd: OG&E states no solar rebates; cannot buy SRECs
items.export_compensation: Bi-directional meter plus extra production meter (OK); excess at on/off-peak avoided energy cost; TOU required with solar

items.program_name: Residential Service Time of Day (RSTOD) Rate Code 028
items.on_peak_window: Jun-Oct billing months weekdays 2-7pm on-peak (excl Juneteenth, Jul 4, Labor Day); Nov-May no on-peak
items.peak_offpeak_rates: Jun-Oct: 24.8475c on-peak / 5.1016c all other kWh; Nov-May tiered 7.9241c first 475 kWh, 5.2529c next 775, 3.5221c above; $17.00/mo base (eff 1/30/2025; before fuel/tax riders)
items.export_compensation: NEBO / QF per OCC net metering rules

items.program_name: Residential Service (RS) standard seasonal tiered rate (baseline for TOD)

items.incentive_structure: enrollment prepaid card + annual prepaid card
items.incentive_value_usd: $50 prepaid card per thermostat enrolled; +$25 prepaid card per thermostat each summer connected; entry to win one of three $1,000 cards for skipping no event
items.event_limits: Thermostat up to 4 F; typically 2 hr, max 4 hr; weekdays 2-7pm Jun-Sep; max 16 events per season
items.stackable_with: TOD Rate 028; VPP Rate 036 (per program terms)

items.program_name: Power Hours - legacy DLC event credit ($2.50/event)
items.incentive_value_usd: $2.50 bill credit per registered thermostat per event (up to 16 events = $40/yr); older $110 thermostat rebate on up to 2 thermostats
items.event_limits: Up to 16 events Jun-Oct; opt-out forfeits credit

items.incentive_value_usd: $32 per average kW savings; +5% bonus if all peak events participated; >250 businesses enrolled
items.event_limits: Notified before events; participate in as many as desired; no penalty for opt-out

items.incentive_structure: $/MWh event credit at SPP day-ahead LMP
items.incentive_value_usd: Credit = curtailed kW x event hours x price; price = avg SPP DA LMP for event hours, floor $100/MWh
items.event_limits: Event when SPP DA LMP > $200/MWh for 2+ consecutive hrs; price quoted by 4pm day prior; no non-compliance charges; min 1,000 kW curtailable; 1-yr initial term

items.program_name: Residential Service Electric Vehicle (RSEV) Rate Code 029
items.on_peak_window: Jun-Oct weekdays 2-7pm on-peak; super-off-peak 11pm-6am all days year-round
items.peak_offpeak_rates: Jun-Oct: 24.8475c on / 3.0451c super-off / 8.4497c other; Nov-May: 3.0451c super-off / 6.1045c other; $17.00/mo (eff 1/30/2025)

items.program_name: Public Electric Vehicle Charging (PEVC) Rate Code 227
items.incentive_structure: TOU energy-only rate for public charging (no demand charge)
items.peak_offpeak_rates: Off-peak 4.5838c/kWh; on-peak 7.8256c/kWh; $37.75/mo base; no DG or NEBO allowed
items.export_compensation: No DG/NEBO/QF SPS allowed on this tariff
